title: Weekend Lane Contraction Along Jalan Magazine & Komtar
body: Two-lane contraflow will be in effect near Komtar Interchange (S19) from Saturday 10:00 PM to Monday 5:00 AM to facilitate diaphragm wall cage lowering and concrete pouring.

title: Night Viaduct Segment Launching at Bayan Lepas FIZ
body: Precast box girder segment launching using overhead gantry cranes will take place along Jalan Sultan Azlan Shah between Free Industrial Zone (FIZ) (S06) and Jalan Tengah (S07) from 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM.

title: Geotechnical & Marine Barge Survey in Penang Strait
body: Marine borehole investigation barges are operating along the Cross-Channel Link alignment between Macallum (S18) and Penang Sentral (S20). Ferry operations remain unaffected.

title: Covered Pedestrian Walkway Realigned at USM & Sungai Dua
body: A new barrier-free covered walkway with solar lighting and tactile paving has opened outside USM main gate near Station S13 (Gelugor / USM) to maintain safe student and resident access.

title: Utility Relocation Completed Ahead of Schedule at Macallum
body: High-voltage cable and water main diversion works along Gat Lebuh Macallum (Station S18) have been completed. Road surface reinstatement and permanent line markings are now open to traffic.

title: Public Feedback & Business Premise Support Portal Open
